title: Retain native chemistry scope in middle-step descriptions
description: Both middle-step membership descriptions say mapped Rhea endpoints preserve the complete native chemistry and selected direction. These events intentionally retain MetaCyc:KDGALDOL-RXN and MetaCyc:TSA-REDUCT-RXN because current candidate Rhea equations do not preserve the native CPD-26279 (2R) stereochemistry. The edge-local native membership assertions and locators themselves are correct. Narrow the two descriptions to native membership/chemistry; retain exact IDs, graph topology and source assertions.
observed_text: One native core event; mapped Rhea endpoints preserve the complete native chemistry and selected direction.
